probe_scope: A copy of the generated desktop entry retained the same quoted executable path and changed only gui to --version; gio launch executed this non-GUI probe.
steps: Install into a private prefix containing spaces.
Validate the installed desktop entry with desktop-file-validate.
Parse Exec with GLib and match exactly the executable path and gui argument.
Launch a copy through GIO with only gui changed to --version.
Verify Icon=zmcl and the corresponding installed SVG exists.
Uninstall the test prefix and clean its private temporary directory.
